reject: domain-specific actuator taxonomy as generic architecture
admission and execution in one authority surface
broker as a parallel policy/authority engine

contract: EffectGateway is the only component that may invoke side-effect adapters.
AuthorityLedger must bind exact consumer identity/key, CETA operation and consequence before execution.
An Execute or Rollback transition durably prepares/reserves its exact permit intent before canonical transition commit.
A prepared permit may be resumed only for the exact persisted intent after restart; it may not reopen into general authority.
Adapter routing is validated before authority is prepared or consumed.
Authority is consumed before the adapter is invoked.
Every adapter invocation is signed by EffectGateway and bound to permit, intent, consequence, adapter identity, gateway identity and gateway key.
An exception after consumption defaults to INDETERMINATE because absence of effect cannot be inferred.
Every execution receipt is gateway-signed; its hash alone is not an identity proof.
The executor receipt is an execution claim, not proof of resulting external reality.
EffectVerifier accepts only a signed independent observation from a configured observer key distinct from the executor.
PARTIALLY_APPLIED and INDETERMINATE cannot close as verified without reconciliation.
No adapter may authorize itself, commit epistemic state, or certify its own result.
